extracted_by: Extracted at build time by Claude from the transcript text (the same job llm.extract_guidance does with a key), then checked against the next calls and the reported quarterly numbers. Cached per ticker per quarter.

items.promise: 15% to 20% a year over three to five years
items.quote: So, this guidance of 15 %-20%, you look more that we have the way we are running business, the way Indian macros are behaving, we believe 15% to 20%, three to five-year kind of horizon is certainly to be delivered on a CAGR basis kind of a thing.
items.why: Filed results show first-half revenue up 19.1% (Rs 41,970 crore against Rs 35,248 crore), though Q2 alone grew 10.1%.

note: Titan gives growth ranges but no numeric margin guidance; it says it anchors jewellery margin around 11%.
